name: Springtails (collembola)
description: Springtails - small wingless insects grazing on fungal hyphae, both saprophytic and mycorrhizal. Functional group aggregating all collembolan species of the site, measured together by the source. Reported biomass (metrics.biomass) is in kg C per hectare, yearly average, from Table A1 of van Altena et al. 2016.
